examples.label: Résumé upload on a job application
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-file-field" site="Global" id="apply-resume" name="application[resume]" value="" label="Attach your résumé" />

PDF or Word, up to 5 MB. A person reads every application — nothing here is screened automatically.

examples.label: Supporting documents, several at once
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-file-field" site="Global" id="claim-documents" name="claim[documents][]" value="" label="Supporting documents" multiple />

Hold Shift to pick more than one. Photographs of paper receipts are fine.

examples.label: Profile photo rejected for being too large
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-file-field" site="Global" id="profile-avatar" name="user[avatar]" value="" label="Profile photo" errors={["That image is larger than 2 MB. Please choose a smaller one."]} />

examples.label: Receipt on an expense claim, with the field emphasised
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-file-field" site="Global" id="expense-receipt" name="expense[receipt]" value="" label="Receipt or invoice" color="primary" space="small" />

Claims without a receipt are held until finance can match them to a card statement.
